name: @j3-bots/desktop
description: Persistent AI teammates on your own machine.

scripts.dev: vp run --filter @j3-bots/web build && vp pack && node node_modules/electron/install.js && node scripts/launch.ts
scripts.smoke: vp run --filter @j3-bots/web build && vp pack && node node_modules/electron/install.js && vp test run --config ../../vite.config.ts --dir test
scripts.package: vp run --filter @j3-bots/web build && vp pack && electron-builder --publish never
